semantic_text:
1. Actor and author Georgie Takei speaks to local school groups at the Library on May 10.
2. Somapa Thai Dance Company performs in the Coolidge Auditorium on May 23 to mark Asian American Pacific Islander Heritage Month.
3. Visitors mingle with costumed Library staff members during Fantasy Book Night on May 16.
4. Geri Halliwell-Horner, aka Ginger Spice of the Spice Girls, tours the Main Reading Room on May 8.
5. Elli Kim of the Asian Division shows Library collections items to Hyundong Cho, the Republic of Korea’s ambassador to the United States, on May 20.
6. Librarian of Congress Carla Hayden interviews actress and author Whoopi Goldberg in the Coolidge Auditorium on May 10.
